source.project: NinoSalud v1.0 regional dengue surveillance completeness / symptom-to-recorded-attendance timing
source.raw_source: GORE Piura open-data regional dengue CSV, supplied by participant

notes: ANO is a surveillance cohort/year code; notification/attendance date may belong to an adjacent calendar year.
The data dictionary defines FECHA_NOTIFICACION as date the person attended the health center, NOT proven date of central reporting. Symptom-to-visit interval is not reporting delay.
The extract contains 2023 data cut in May, no 2024 records, and 2025 and partial 2026 from a July 2 2026 snapshot.
The regional dataset page describes confirmed plus possible cases, but this CSV has no diagnosis-status column.
FECHA_INGRESO precedes FECHA_NOTIFICACION in many rows. Do not compute a trusted reporting lag from their difference.
No individual IDs are present: do not deduplicate apparently identical records or identify people.
Dataset for 2025 is not directly comparable with national confirmed-only counts.
No raw case-level data, sex, age, locality or health center names included in shared prototype.
2026 comparison is only year-to-date; 2023 only Jan-May.
Delay summarization uses only nonnegative onset-to-attendance intervals <= 90 days. Excluded counts remain visible.
Calendar-month series uses date of recorded attendance in the cohort calendar year (boundary spillovers excluded).
